'''Sidona''' is a geographical region of the [[Borderland]] nation of [[Saldaea]]. Its lord is [[Davram Bashere]].

==Parallels==
The name Sidona is reminiscent of the ancient Phonecian city of Sidon.  There is also a modern day city called  Sidon, located in the nation of Lebanon.
